status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Hamilton (back) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
status.longComment: Hamilton suffered a back injury in the fourth quarter of Sunday's matchup. The starting defensive tackle logged five tackles before succumbing to injury. It is unclear how significant the back issue is and whether it will affect the starter long-term.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: The Jaguars placed Green (elbow) on injured reserve Wednesday.
status.longComment: Green sustained the injury while on punt coverage during the Jaguars' 34-10 win over the Browns in Week 1. The injury is severe enough for him to warrant a stint on injured reserve, meaning he'll be forced to miss at least the next four games. The earliest Green is eligible to return from IR is Week 6 against the Texans on Sunday, Oct. 18.
